id: title:jurajmajerik:highlight template variables in playground editors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new React component and utility for parsing and displaying template variables with highlighting, supporting AI prompt editing and variable substitution.
review.reason: The chunk adds a new React component, TemplateVariableTextArea, and a utility function, segmentTemplateText, while removing the previous LemonTextArea. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: replacing an existing UI component with a new one that includes specific styling and variable highlighting, and adding the parsing logic required for that new behavior.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the implementation of the removed functions or the full implementation of the new component, so the complete behavior and test coverage are not fully demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the visible replacement and addition of the component and its supporting utility, not on unverified outcomes.
